headings.usage: Use exclusively for H1, H2, H3 headings. Apply 'tracking-tight' to enhance the brutalist/modern feel.

body.usage: Primary UI font for paragraphs, labels, forms, and general dashboard content. Highly legible.

mono.usage: Crucial for numerical data tables, IDs, timestamps, and the AI Assistant's 'tool-calling' log visualizer.

colors.strategy: Monochromatic Swiss aesthetic. Extreme data clarity. Rely on neutral layers (white/charcoal) for hierarchy. Use the primary accent (Vermilion Red) strictly for critical alerts, primary CTAs, and active states—never for generic decoration.

marketing_page.pattern: Bento Grid (Mode A: The Tetris Grid)
marketing_page.structure: Overlapping asymmetric sections. Hero image uses a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent) to ensure the stark white Cabinet Grotesk typography pops.
marketing_page.components: Custom HTML/Tailwind for layouts. No Shadcn container cards.

dashboard.spacing: Dense (p-4 or p-6, gap-4 to gap-6)
dashboard.structure: Collapsible left sidebar for deep navigation. Fixed topbar for context (Search, Tenant Switcher, Notifications). Flat surfaces (no drop shadows by default). 1px crisp borders.
dashboard.data_tables: Right-align all numerical columns. Left-align text. Use IBM Plex Mono for digits to ensure vertical alignment.
dashboard.cards: Subtle border (border-border), bg-card. Radius is extremely small (2px) to feel sharp and technical.

components.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Crisp hover states with high-contrast ring on focus.
components.ai_assistant: Floating panel or Command-K interface. Incorporate a 'Terminal' log aesthetic for the tool-calling steps (using mono font, muted colors) to highlight the 'AI working' phase before showing the conversational result.
components.navigation: Sidebar must cleanly display hierarchy (Organization > Campus > Unit). Use subtle hover states (bg-secondary) without moving text.

images.description: Striking modern architecture. Use as hero background with a heavy dark overlay for the SaaS platform.
Modern green-roof building. Use for the multi-tenant/campus management feature section.
Students collaborating in a modern setting. Use for the Student/Parent module highlight.
Stone crest logo. Use as a realistic placeholder for College/School logos in the dashboard Tenant Switcher.

accessibility.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, table rows, AI chat inputs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='tenant-switcher-dropdown', data-testid='ai-chat-submit').
accessibility.contrast: Text must maintain at least 4.5:1 against backgrounds. Charts must rely on shades/patterns, not just hues.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all React components as .jsx or .js files, as typescript is not set up.
Install and use '@phosphor-icons/react' for a sharp, enterprise-grade look.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts (achieving overlapping asymmetry) and Shadcn UI heavily for the dense dashboard interfaces (Tables, Selects, Dialogs).
Customize Shadcn components via Tailwind config to use a tighter radius ('rounded-sm' or 0.125rem) to achieve the requested Linear/Salesforce premium feel.
Inject fonts via standard HTML <link> or CSS @import in index.css. Do NOT use next/font as this is a standard React setup.
